query: Key contributions and follow-ups of 'Attention Is All You Need' (2017)
highlights: The paper introduces the Transformer architecture which relies solely on attention mechanisms without recurrent or convolutional layers [1, p.3, Fig.1:].
Scaled dot-product attention mechanism is used where queries, keys, and values are linearly projected from the input [1, p.4, Fig.2:].
Multi-head attention allows the model to jointly attend to information from different representation subspaces [1, p.4, Fig.2:].
Table 3 shows variations on the Transformer architecture with performance metrics on English-to-German translation task [1, p.9].

Table 2 compares the Transformer's BLEU scores against previous state-of-the-art models on English-to-German and English-to-French translations, demonstrating superior performance at lower training costs [1, p.8].
